body:
Explicit bounded local implementation child of ticket:corvint:main:V1-0595, within ticket:corvint:main:V1-0591. This proposal is read-only and awaits independent root review and a safe source/queue admission window. The native CREATE result must supply the child ID; no ID is guessed here.

Local scope includes all 19 consumer families C01-C19 and assembler/release additions A01/A02 across S0, S0E, S1-S9, current-public source port, lossless stable workflow migration, runner integration, specifications, fixtures, CI, and fresh CEM/seal evidence. All 55 future local write namespaces from the full scope audit are retained; exact unknown filenames remain INCOMPLETE and each implementation slice must freeze its actual expanded paths before writing. The broad scopes do not imply that every enclosed file changes or that the per-slice 200 actual changed-path budget is satisfied. gitauth/gitrun remain read-only; edits require a reviewed scope amendment.

Only bounded trusted local qualification is included: pinned runtime/toolchain tuples, isolated fixture roots/caches, owned processes with explicit cleanup, required native loopback, private disposable native Tasks stores, and actual producer/runner/native/portable artifact bindings. Unknown or unsupported tuples remain explicit gaps; no primary Tasks store serves as a test fixture. Exact runtime/filesystem/network effects require admission before each case. Ordinary required root-coordinated ticket bookkeeping is separate from qualification fixture writes. Preserve helper Tasks source and current public CI changes.

externalUnbounded=false follows this child's explicit local boundary. It is not a change to the parent's full external scope, a QUALIFIED effect claim, or evidence of execution/adoption. Independent external-authored consumer conformance and matched external outcome validation remain unfinished obligations of V1-0595/V1-0596 and the V1-0591 umbrella. No external data gathering, outreach, unbounded external execution, release publication, or promotion is authorized by this child. Default selection behavior may be implemented and tested locally, but promotion remains blocked until all governing parent qualifications are satisfied. Ready-for-review PR publication follows standing owner authorization after required review/checks.

After native CREATE assigns the child ID, root must append this child as a required completion dependency of V1-0595, preserving its existing dependency set and all acceptance criteria. V1-0591 already retains the V1-0595 umbrella relationship; record the child linkage in root coordination without introducing a parent-child dependency cycle. This child must not depend on completion of its own parent. An unlinked local success cannot complete the umbrella.
